summary: QA PASS — Forge v2 Visual Themes cleared the release gate. All acceptance criteria verified: 6 pre-built themes (Default, Clean, Bold, Minimal, Corporate, Startup) with light+dark variants, accent color picker (swatches + hex input + color well), 3-state dark mode (light/dark/system), theme persistence per-roadmap, real-time sync via Socket.IO, PNG export + shared URL respect active theme. Robert flags (focus ring skip-link and ThemeCard keyboard pattern) are non-blocking post-ship items. RG-15 Zod fix confirmed clean. Ready to ship.
